objective: Measure the increase in the conditional source-real signed Thomson lower endpoint using the newly certified q/16 floor and previously certified positive V66 weights.

primary: Verify task fingerprint and member hashes, exact proof joins, global positivity premise of the baseline, and all V112 baseline bins before execution.

Read the frozen geometry and the original V66 receipt. Check each closed child interval is contained in its V66 parent, unique floor claim and bin. Check complete contiguous support with no interior overlap with the prior credited V111 strip.
For each child [a,c] use its parent W_lower>0. Evaluate exact rational mass M=((1+c)^3-(1+a)^3)/3 and l=(q/16)*W_lower*M. Record l and round each local l downward to the 2^-100 grid.

Sum the new local grid lower amounts per bin. Add only the new support contribution to that bin’s prior lower endpoint. For 650:700 explicitly show the new support ends at the first endpoint of the already credited V111 strip. If positive-length overlap is detected, stop rather than add; reuse would require splitting support and taking the maximum certified local lower bound on a shared piece.

Sum bin intervals to the new global conditional signed interval. Check each resulting lower endpoint is no larger than its preserved upper endpoint. Report exact gain, downward rounding loss, new global width, fractional reduction relative to V112, and ratio to the provisional 4e-9 width goal.
separate_control: Use a separate process and no producer code or receipts. Independently derive the partition from full V66 rows, exact claim endpoints, signed baseline bin cuts and V111 protected strip. Traverse in reverse order and compare exact ordered membership only after computing.
Use the factorized mass M=(c-a)*((1+a)^2+(1+a)*(1+c)+(1+c)^2)/3 and use integer divmod for directed local rounding. Independently aggregate the global interval and bin changes.
Require exact equality of final sums, rounded and unrounded contributions, protected support, upper endpoints and baseline coverage. Record first inconsistent row or bin, if any.
acceptance_criteria: Both implementations yield identical exact bounds with a strictly positive global lower improvement, no double counting, unchanged prior upper endpoints and complete coverage of all 1304 pieces.
rejection_criteria: A verified input/domain mismatch, duplicated positive-length support or a new lower endpoint exceeding its existing upper endpoint invalidates the affected candidate update.
inconclusive_criteria: Any missing mandatory provenance, unverified range, incomplete control or unclosed arithmetic mismatch prevents promoting a new global interval.
stop_condition: One fixed primary sum and one independent control, then stop at dual agreement, first failed mandatory gate, or 120 combined wall seconds. Preserve earlier accepted results on failure.
expected_output: Exact signed source-optical contribution receipts, a validated interval update or concrete blocker, appended journal and one Result Ingestion task.
